page.title: Routing Rules
page.description: Configure routing rules for model requests

rules.title: Routing Rules
rules.enableRuleDescription: Rule will be active and applied to matching requests
rules.chainRuleDescription: After this rule matches, re-evaluate routing rules using the resolved provider/model as the new context. Useful for composing rules, e.g. normalize a model alias first, then route based on the canonical name.
rules.priorityHint: Lower numbers = higher priority (0 is highest)
rules.routingTargetRequired: At least one routing target is required
rules.targetWeightMustBePositive: Each target weight must be greater than 0
rules.targetWeightsMustSumToOne: Target weights must sum to 1, current total: {{total}}
rules.noRulesDesc: Create your first routing rule to get started

tree.title: Routing Tree
tree.pageDescription: Read-only decision tree visualization of routing rules

complexityRouter.title: Complexity Router
complexityRouter.description: Route requests based on complexity tiers
complexityRouter.headerDescription: Tune how incoming requests are classified into four tiers. Thresholds and keyword lists feed the
complexityRouter.headerDescriptionSuffix: field that routing rules can target.
complexityRouter.keywordListsDescription: Lowercased and deduplicated on save. Each list requires at least one entry.
complexityRouter.typeKeywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter
complexityRouter.restoreDefaultsDescription: This will reset all tier boundaries and keyword lists to the factory defaults. Your current configuration will be lost. This action cannot be undone.
complexityRouter.configUnavailable: No complexity router configuration is available.

validation.mustBeGreaterThanSimpleMedium: Must be greater than Simple → Medium
validation.mustBeGreaterThanMediumComplex: Must be greater than Medium → Complex
validation.simpleAbove: Scores at or below this are classified as SIMPLE.
validation.mediumAbove: Scores above simple_medium and at or below this are MEDIUM.
validation.complexAbove: Scores above this are REASONING. Everything in between is COMPLEX.

permissionDenied: You don't have permission to access routing rules

routingRules.emptyTitle: Routing rules direct requests using CEL conditions
routingRules.emptyDescription: Create CEL-based rules to route requests by model, provider, budget, or custom attributes. Control which provider or model handles each request.
